headline_result: Best model: Gradient Boosting Regressor with test R2=0.8394, RMSE=0.3728 ($100k units).
notes: Median income (MedInc) is consistently the strongest single predictor of median house value, consistent with the well-documented behaviour of this dataset/domain. Tree-based ensembles (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) outperform plain Linear Regression, indicating meaningful non-linear and interaction effects among the features (e.g. income combined with location).
